heading: What Our
subheading: Feedback themes from verified customer reviews across Aligarh and the surrounding district.

items.name: Residential Customer
items.text: The team was experienced and polite throughout — from the site survey to final commissioning. Installation was completed on the timeline they promised, with quality hardware and no shortcuts.

items.name: Commercial Client
items.text: We compared several local vendors and Greentech was the most transparent about pricing — clear discounting, no hidden charges, and a system sized exactly to our load rather than oversold.

items.name: Farm Owner
items.text: Switching to a solar submersible pump ended our dependence on diesel and unreliable rural grid power. The VFD system tracks sunlight through the day exactly as explained.

items.name: Group Housing Society
items.text: Highly customizable system for our society's shared load, and the subsidy paperwork was handled end-to-end without a single rejection from the portal.
